courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 飛機鋁合金蒙皮成形
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課的工程脈絡由「方向模數與應變判讀」推進到「冷卻流路的熱量收支」，最後以「高溫試驗的不確定度」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
courses.summaryEn: The engineering progression moves from Directional modulus and strain interpretation through Cooling-path heat balance to Uncertainty in high-temperature tests. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

history.title: 航空渦輪單晶葉片概念
history.text: 本課的工程脈絡由「方向模數與應變判讀」推進到「冷卻流路的熱量收支」，最後以「高溫試驗的不確定度」整合。官方資料用於核對原理及證據流程，本教材不把教學假設歸為任何原廠數據或新發現。
history.textEn: The engineering progression moves from Directional modulus and strain interpretation through Cooling-path heat balance to Uncertainty in high-temperature tests. Official references support principles and evidence workflows; teaching assumptions are not attributed to manufacturers or presented as new findings.

courses.connection: 以「區分單晶方向、高溫潛變與塗層界面效應」為主線，在單晶試片資料與高溫材料模型中依序完成方向模數與應變判讀、塗層與基材膨脹差、冷卻流路的熱量收支、鑄造孔隙與局部缺陷、取向、批次和熱處理追溯及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
courses.connectionEn: Follow Distinguish crystal orientation, high-temperature creep and coating interfaces in a Single-crystal coupon data and high-temperature material models, progressing through Directional modulus and strain interpretation, Coating-substrate expansion mismatch, Cooling-path heat balance, Casting pores and local defects, Orientation, batch and heat-treatment provenance, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
